technology_name: MAGNETORHEOLOGICAL FLUID-BASED ROTARY DAMPER FOR REAL-TIME SUSPENSION DAMPING ADJUSTMENT AND METHOD OF OPERATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Active Suspension Hardware / MR Fluid Damper
problem_solved: Standard vehicle shock absorbers utilize fixed fluid orifices that cannot adjust stiffness in real-time, resulting in poor ride comfort and high mechanical chassis wear across varied terrains.
description: An active rotary dampening assembly consisting of a robust outer casing, a dynamic central rotating disk flanked by a series of structured static disks, and an internal magnetorheological (MR) fluid cavity regulated by integrated electromagnetic induction coils.
applications: Adaptive automotive suspension tracking loops, military all-terrain vehicle chassis dampening, high-speed rail car stabilizers, and active robotic limb joint absorption.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemicals, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
